name: account-01
title: Account 01 - A Record Of Who Owes What And What They May Do
description: An account in full: a name, a kind, a reference in the mono face as an identifier is machine notation, a set of facts composed through the Fact List component, a balance or a plan reading, a slot for the caller's own recent activity, the regions and surfaces the account spans with the status tones and the caller own words, and a slot for the caller's own controls. An account record is not a settings page: an account is a fact about who owes what and a settings page is a set of controls that change it, so this Block ships no control of its own and the two slots are never props it acts on.
